title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
LSEG has immediate opening for a Full Stack Engineer. We’re building the next generation of capital markets technology. Global capital markets are an ocean of fast-moving, interrelated and complex data. We are looking for passionate and enthusiastic problem-solvers with an interest in capital markets data to join us as we continue providing technology innovation and support to the world’s leading global capital markets companies.

Your strategic role

The Full Stack Engineer will help develop clean, powerful, and user-friendly user interfaces and the associated AWS backend components which will be used by professional financial users, modelers and other clients. This role will also develop system administrator-facing tools and associated backend components to manage internal processes.

The considerable complexity of capital markets technology, along with the premium placed on high-integrity, low-latency data, demands that the engineer quickly attain and understand the nuance of LSEG’s proprietary data delivery platform. The candidate must also have the easy personal skills required to interact with engineers on the customer side.

Work Qualifications

Ability to write clean and functional code on both the front-end and back-end.
Excellent communication skills and a team player
Ability to use out-of-the-box UI development framework tools and integrate them into existing solutions
Basic knowledge of current software design patterns
Participation in the technical design of applications and in larger system design efforts

Required Skills

2+ years hands-on experience with TypeScript and NodeJS
2+ years hands-on experience with server-side web application development and SQL
React development experience
Experience with cloud infrastructure platforms, such as AWS, GCP or Azure
Knowledge of associated web development processes and technologies
Knowledge of both unit and functional testing using Jest, Cypress, or other similar technologies

Nice to haves

Knowledge of the Python language and Jupyter
VS Code extensions development
An understanding of financial markets and instruments
Experience with distributed systems

Career Stage:

Senior Associate

Compensation Information:

LSEG is committed to offering competitive Compensation and Benefits. The anticipated annual gross base salary for this position is between 64,200 € - 107,000 €. Please be aware base salary ranges may vary by geographic location. In addition to our offered base salary, this role is eligible for our Annual Bonus Plan (”bonus plan”). Target Bonus % will be commensurate with role level and posted career stage. Individual salary will be reflective of job-related knowledge, skills and equivalent experience.

LSEG unlocks the power of markets to create opportunities across the global economy.

Through our connected network of market infrastructure, data and analytics, we help customers access capital, manage risk and make confident decisions.

Our insights bring clarity to complex markets, and our trusted services ensure resilience and stability. With deep expertise and global scale, we partner with customers to drive innovation and shape the future of finance.

Few organisations operate at the scale, complexity and reach of LSEG. Here, you’ll work alongside experts, be inspired to deliver your best work and help shape what’s next for our business and the global economy.

Guided by our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change, we bring together diverse perspectives, encourage fresh thinking, and create an environment where learning never stops.

Join more than 26,000 colleagues across 60 countries, supporting customers in over 170 countries. Alongside flexible ways of working, you'll have access to benefits that support your wellbeing and your future, including 26 weeks' parental leave, healthcare, retirement planning and a wellness allowance. Through the LSEG Foundation and two paid volunteering days each year, you’ll also have opportunities to get involved in your local community and support causes that matter to you.
